description: Find any company of the coverage or any entity of the map of relationships (a bank, an owner, a subsidiary, a customer or a supplier) by name, ticker (AAPL, 0700.HK, TLKM), CIK, LEI or id, and the companies and documents that a question names (Apple revenue growth, UK utilities). A whole name ranks first; an entity that is no company of the coverage has relationships and no figures, which not_included states. Each result names its kind, the ids that the other tools take (company for get_company and get_series, entity for get_relationships, id for fetch), the tools that answer about it and, for a company, its sector, whether it reports quarters or fiscal years only and its latest period. An empty query lists the coverage, by country where one is given. Every answer states count, whether it is complete and next, the cursor for the rest.

country.description: ISO 3166 country code, for example US, GB, ID, SG, HK or JP

cursor.description: the next of an earlier answer, for the next page of the same call

kinds.description: the kinds of result (default every kind)

query.description: a name or part of it, a ticker, a CIK, an LEI, an id or a question; empty lists the coverage

name: search
title: Search companies, entities and documents
